roots.documentation:
### `compare` This compound compares two values and returns true or false. It currently supports float, float3, long, double, 4x4, string and int inputs.

**Note**: Comparison is performed member by member. *** ## Input ***test***
The comparison operation: equal, less, greater, less or equal, greater or equal, not equal. ***input1*** °°°°°
The first value. ***input2*** °°°°°
The second value. *** ## Outputs ***bool***
Result of the comparison, True or False.
